context: A married couple discuss taxes at the kitchen table
purpose: Teach: 控除/アイディア/任意/幸運/配当/開業/相続/軌道

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、今年こそ医療費控除をちゃんと申告したいんだけど、領収書まとめてくれた?
lines.en: Hey, this year I really want to file the medical expense deduction properly—did you sort the receipts?
lines.style: soft maternal tone, slightly tired evening voice, gently nudging her husband across the table

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ああ、台所の引き出しに入れてあるよ。それでさ、ちょっと面白いアイディアがあるんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, I put them in the kitchen drawer. So listen, I've actually got an interesting idea.
lines.style: warm husbandly voice, mildly excited, leaning forward like he's pitching a small plan

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うちの株、今年は配当もそこそこ入ったし、確定申告は任意だけどやった方が得じゃない?
lines.en: Our stocks paid out decent dividends this year too, so even though filing is optional, isn't it better to do it?
lines.style: practical wife voice, working through numbers aloud, slightly leaning toward persuasion

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そう、それなんだよ。実は思い切って会社を辞めて、来年あたり開業しようかと思ってて。
lines.en: Right, exactly that. Honestly, I'm thinking of quitting the company and maybe opening my own business next year.
lines.style: lowered serious voice, slightly nervous announcement, testing the waters with his wife

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええっ、開業!?ちょっと待ってよ、急にそんな大きい話されても困るわよ。
lines.en: What?! Starting a business?! Wait a second, you can't drop something that huge on me out of nowhere.
lines.style: shocked maternal voice, half-rising in pitch, equal parts worry and disbelief

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 落ち着いて。親父から相続した土地もあるし、最初の二、三年で軌道に乗せられると思うんだ。
lines.en: Calm down. We've got the land I inherited from my dad, and I think I can get it on track in two or three years.
lines.style: steadying husband voice, reassuring but firm, like he's already done the math in his head

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 相続した土地ねえ…まあ、あれを活かせるなら確かに大きいけど、本当に大丈夫?
lines.en: The inherited land, huh… well, if you can actually put it to use that's huge, but are you really sure?
lines.style: softening but still cautious wife voice, weighing risk and possibility out loud

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 大丈夫、税理士の友達もついててくれるしさ。あとはちょっとした幸運があればなんとかなるよ。
lines.en: It'll be fine, I've got that tax accountant buddy backing me up. After that, with a bit of luck we'll manage.
lines.style: warm confident chuckle, husband trying to lighten the mood with a small grin

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう、幸運頼みはやめてよね。でも…うん、一緒に考えるから、ちゃんと数字見せてちょうだい。
lines.en: Come on, don't go relying on luck. But… okay, I'll think it through with you, so show me the actual numbers.
lines.style: softening wife voice with affectionate exasperation, finally meeting him halfway across the table
